## Summary

- What changed and why (1–3 bullets)

## Scope scale

Where should these clips live after import?

- [ ] **Shared** (`.csvs/shared.json` — team, committed to Git)
- [ ] **Personal** (`.csvs/personal.json` — one developer, usually gitignored)
- [ ] **Global** (extension global storage — all workspaces)

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or internal-only URLs
- [ ] Generic enough for other teams (no project-specific paths unless clearly labeled as examples)
- [ ] English clip text (optional `*.de.md` locale files welcome)
- [ ] Labels updated if this adds a new pack or topic

## Test plan

- [ ] Imported or opened in Code Spots multi-root workspace without JSON errors
- [ ] AI clips copy correctly from Commands (✍️)
